title: Registered-agent eligibility rules, per jurisdiction
description: Records who may serve as an LLC's registered agent: whether an individual may hold the seat, whether the LLC itself may be its own agent, what conditions attach to that individual, whether a commercial mail receiving agency address is acceptable, and the address rule - the last three in the state's own words. This namespace is authoritative for registered-agent eligibility; contact details stay in entitysearch-state-data.

individualCanBeAgent.description: Whether a natural person may serve as the registered agent - the filer, a member, a manager or any other qualifying individual, as opposed to a commercial agent that must be hired. This is a different question from llcCanBeOwnAgent, which asks only about the company as an entity, and the two have different answers in every state that bars entity self-agency while admitting a resident individual. false is a researched finding and requires evidence; null means not yet researched. Conditions on the individual - residency, membership, age - belong in notes, not in this boolean.
individualCanBeAgent.$comment: E13. Added 2026-08-10 because the published boolean answered a narrower question than the one a reader asks.

individualRule.description: The conditions a natural person must meet to serve, in the state's own words: residency, age, role, membership. Verbatim and unedited, the same licence addressRule has - never paraphrased, classified or shortened into a badge. Where the eligibility provision attaches no condition beyond the address rule, quote the provision that attaches none: an absence of conditions is recorded by the sentence that fails to impose them, never by null. null means the eligibility wording has not been read.
individualRule.$comment: E14. Added 2026-08-10: individualCanBeAgent true renders as 'allowed', which is too strong where the state qualifies who that individual may be.

llcCanBeOwnAgent.description: Whether the LLC itself may serve as its own registered agent. false is a researched finding and requires evidence from the registered-agent provision that would have said so; null means not yet researched.

cmraAllowed.description: Whether a commercial mail receiving agency (CMRA) may serve as the registered office or address. false is a researched finding and requires evidence.

addressRule.description: The address requirement in the state's own words: physical street address, P.O. box policy, business-office requirement.

notes.description: Anything the fields cannot carry without lying: the definitional calls behind llcCanBeOwnAgent and cmraAllowed.

needsReview.description: What is missing and what would settle it.

type.description: Source class, for deriving record confidence mechanically. null where none of the classes fits.

lastVerified.description: The date the cited pages were retrieved and every quoted passage was mechanically confirmed to occur in them.

quote.description: One contiguous verbatim passage, copied from the page as retrieved, artefacts included. Never assembled across an ellipsis, never taken from a search snippet, never tidied.

supports.description: Which value in the enclosing object this passage grounds, by field name (individualCanBeAgent, individualRule, llcCanBeOwnAgent, cmraAllowed, addressRule). A record carrying several passages is only honest if each one says what it is evidence for. One passage may ground two values; repeat it under each supports rather than letting one entry claim both.
